QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Colleague
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012111##k back in #m100000000# is in urgent need of your help. Head back to #b#m100040000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012111# thanked you for all the help you gave #p1022006#, and says that another scholar could use your incredible errand-running abilities. He wants you to help #b#p1032104##k in #b#m101000000##k with her important research on ancient organisms.

0.0: Mercedes, good to see you! I've been following up on our research, and I think I'm on the verge of making a huge discovery about how this puppet works.
0.1: Oh! And my old teacher in #m102000000# wanted me to thank you again for helping with his research. Really. He won't shut up about the book you gave him.
0.2: I told one of my peers about you, and now he really wants to meet you. I don't suppose you could go see him for me?\r\n#b#e(You will be moved to Elluel if you accept.)#n#k

yes.0: My colleague's name is #b#p1032104##k. She studies ancient organisms in #b#m101000000##k. You're from around there, right? That makes you the perfect person to help her out.

no.0: I understand. You're probably pretty busy these days.

1.0: Are you Mercedes? Oh goodness, #p1012111# told me so much about you! To the point of excess, really. Still, it's a pleasure to meet you. I'm #p1032104#.

yes.0: You really are as pretty as #p1012111# said. I thought surely he was exaggerating!

npc.0: #b#p1032104##k is in #b#m100000000##k. You will go see her, won't you?
